content:
The average distance from the Earth to the Sun is approximately 93 million miles (149.6 million kilometers), which is also known as 1 Astronomical Unit (1 AU). However, it's important to note that the Earth's orbit is elliptical, not perfectly circular, so the distance varies slightly throughout the year:

- At its closest point (perihelion), the Earth is about 91.4 million miles (147.1 million kilometers) from the Sun.
- At its farthest point (aphelion), the Earth is about 94.5 million miles (152.1 million kilometers) from the Sun.

Light takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to travel from the Sun to the Earth at this distance.
